title: 2026 Version Ergonomic VESA Monitor Stand, 150mm Spring Height adjustment,, Tool-Free Base, Swivel, Tilt & Rotation, for 26–32" Monitors, 7.28–8.82 lb, 100x100mm Vesa Mount (7.28～8.82LB)
features: BEFORE YOU BUY: Only compatible with 100×100 mm. Not compatible with 75×75 mm VESA mounts.

Meet Our VESA Monitor Stand – Combines 150mm height adjustment, 45° swivel, tilt, portrait/landscape rotation, support for multiple monitor weights, and easy tool-free installation in one ergonomic design.And if you ever need to move the stand (say, to a new desk or office), the quick-release VESA plate lets you detach the monitor in 20 seconds.

Extended 150mm Height Adjustment Range – Enjoy a wider vertical lift from 10.23" to 16.14", offering more flexibility than standard monitor stands to fit sitting, standing, and shared desk setups with true ergonomic comfort.Studies show proper monitor positioning can cut neck pain by 40% (per ergonomic research from the American Chiropractic Association)—and this stand puts that power in your fingertips.

45° Swivel & +10°/-22° Tilt – Match your viewing angle with 45° left/right swivel and precise tilt adjustment for work, gaming, or creative setups.This isn’t just about comfort—it’s about long-term health. By aligning your screen to eye level (the sweet spot for ergonomics), you reduce strain on your cervical spine and eye muscles.

Portrait & Landscape Rotation – Rotate your monitor freely between vertical and horizontal modes for coding, reading, video calls, and content creation.The 90° screen rotation is a game-changer for multi-taskers and collaborators. Programmers can flip their 27-inch monitor to portrait mode to view full lines of code without scrolling. Note: 90°portrait rotation is recommended for monitors up to 27 inches. 32-inch monitors are highly recommender for landscape use only.

100x100mm VESA Compatible with Weight-Specific Support – Designed to match your monitor’s exact size and weight range for optimized balance and long-term stability without sagging.Here’s how it works: The built-in, weight-balanced spring system matches the heft of your 5.07–8.82LB monitor (perfect for 15–32 inch screens). Just light push the screen upward to lift it to eye level, or gently pull it down to a lower position—no awkward cranking, no sudden drops. The stand holds its height securely (no slow sagging, even after months of use)

Quick Tool-Free Base Assembly – Simply insert the arm into the pedestal base and lock it securely with the built-in locking ring—no base screws required. Just attach your monitor to the VESA plate with standard screws and you’re ready to go in minutes.Whether you’re treating yourself or surprising a friend, this stand turns a basic monitor into a tool that works for you—not against you.
